text:
maria_sales: Quick question from a giant payments prospect: they have a 7-year retention + legal-hold requirement for customer-managed keys. Options they want: (A) Redwood acts as escrow holder, (B) customer keeps keys but Redwood provides an unwrap SLA during legal holds, (C) Redwood stores a wrapped backup (never unwrapped). Pricing impact?

alex_infra: Short: we will not accept plaintext KEKs. We can do BYOK (route unwraps to customer KMS) or store wrapped blobs. If Redwood stores wrapped blobs, design needs HSM-backed envelope encryption at rest and strict RBAC.

jon_eng: Tech notes: wrapped-backup = customer provides ciphertext blob (their KMS-encrypted), we store opaque blob. Retrieval flow: customer-auth -> retrieval approval -> deliver blob. We never perform unwrapping. Need format agreement (e.g., AWS KMS ciphertext blob vs CMS). Ask customer to provide sample blob.

felicia_legal: Legal: we can agree to store wrapped blobs only. If Redwood is escrowee for wrapped blobs, contract must include: (1) customer retains sole ownership; (2) Redwood will not attempt to access plaintext; (3) retrievals require documented authorization and will be logged; (4) indemnity and process for compelled disclosure. We should refuse plaintext escrow unless under a very narrow, negotiated enterprise SOW with heavy legal/compliance controls.

paul_product: Product take: ship as "Managed Wrapped Key Backup" enterprise add-on. Pricing model idea: onboarding fee + annual compliance surcharge + storage per-GB + per-retrieval fee (expedited retrieval surcharge). Mark as custom-quote until SOC/PCI review finished.

maria_sales: Customer will push to have Redwood act as escrow for convenience. They asked for a firm price range now. Can we give ballpark?

alex_infra: Ballpark: small infra/DB cost but high compliance overhead. Suggest placeholder in SOW: "Managed wrapped backup (wrapped-only) — custom quote; typical uplift 20-50% on top of base Dedicated pricing depending on compliance scope." That's vague but sets expectation.

jon_eng: Integration questions to hit them with now: KMS vendor (AWS KMS/CloudHSM, Azure KV, Thales), expected unwrap QPS, rotation cadence, sample wrapped blob format, and whether they expect Redwood to retain historical rotated keys across 7 years or only current active key. Also ask if they require retrieval drills (we should).

felicia_legal: I'll prep clause snippets: "Customer retains sole ownership of key material"; "Redwood may only store wrapped key blobs"; "Retrievals require customer authorization and follow retrieval runbook"; "Redwood disclaims liability for customer KMS outages when unwraps are routed to customer KMS."

review_bot: compliance-check: please open `/new-compliance-review managed-wrapped-backup <prospect-name> <scope:retention+retrieval>` before pricing is included in SOW.

maria_sales: Proposed next steps: 1) tell customer we won't hold plaintext; 2) offer wrapped-only managed backup as enterprise add-on (custom quote, needs compliance review); 3) qualify KMS vendor, endpoints, unwrap QPS, rotation cadence, format; 4) offer Dedicated/Private for SLA-backed unwrap routing; 5) loop legal for escrow language. OK?

paul_product: Add requirement: pre-go-live rotation DRY-RUN and retrieval drill as acceptance criteria for managed-backup customers.

alex_infra: I'll draft an ops appendix: storage design (HSM envelope + object store), RBAC, retrieval approval workflow, audit logs, expected RTO for retrievals, and carveouts for customer KMS maintenance.

j on_eng: I'll draft minimal test matrix: `wrap/unwrap smoke`, `rotation dry-run`, `retrieval drill`, `audit-log verification`.

maria_sales: Scheduling a 30m scoping call with prospect tomorrow 10am PT. I'll post the draft reply and the list of integration questions after this thread. :thumbsup:
